content.short: Blum is a Telegram crypto app for perpetual trading, token launches, and bot based market activity on TON.
content.description: Blum is a crypto trading product built around Telegram as its main user interface and growth channel. Official product materials present three core pieces of the platform: Blum Perps for perpetual futures trading, Memepad for launching and trading meme tokens, and bot driven workflows for handling market activity inside Telegram. Its TON connection is strongest in Memepad and wallet flows that use TON and TON Connect, making Blum both a trading product and a token launch venue for users who prefer to operate from Telegram.
content.meta: Blum combines Telegram based trading, bot driven execution, and TON token launch activity in one crypto app experience for active users.
